description: Search mapped tennis, pickleball and padel courts in a covered city or metro area, or around a point. Pass 'city' (e.g. 'Austin, TX', 'Lisbon', 'Los Angeles area'; add 'country' if the name is ambiguous) or 'lat'+'lon' (+'radius_km'). Optional filters: sport, setting (outdoor or indoor), lit, open_to_public, free (mapped as no fee), min_courts. Each result is a venue with the number of courts ('courts' is the total at the venue, 'matched_sport_courts' the number for the requested sport), lighting, surface, access, the nearest park or street ('near'), a map link and the source. Results list courts open to the public first and clubs last; check each result's open_to_public, access_note and 'near'. 'unknown' means not mapped. If fewer than 3 courts match and others were left out only because a property is unmapped, they are added and marked 'matched_unknown'. If no court of the requested sport is mapped, the nearest tennis courts are returned in 'alternatives' (tennis, not the sport asked for). A place that is not covered returns an error; list_coverage shows the covered places. Mapped facts only: no bookings or live availability. Data comes from OpenStreetMap (ODbL), is often incomplete, and every answer carries the data date and attribution.

city.description: A covered city, e.g. 'Austin, TX', 'Long Beach' or 'Tbilisi' (also any city inside a metro area, e.g. 'Santa Monica' or 'Huntington Beach'), or a whole metro area, e.g. 'Los Angeles area' (all of Los Angeles and Orange counties) or 'New York area'. See list_coverage.

country.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. 'Georgia', 'GE', 'US'. Use it when the same city name exists in several countries; with lat/lon it limits the search to that country. Distances are in miles for the US and metres/kilometres elsewhere (distance_km is always given).

free.description: Only courts mapped with no fee (fee=no).

lat.description: Latitude of the search point (use with lon).

lon.description: Longitude of the search point (use with lat).

match_unknown.description: Also return courts where a filtered property is not mapped (unknown).

min_courts.description: Minimum number of courts at the venue.

open_to_public.description: Only courts open to everyone. Returns courts mapped as public, with no fee or inside a park (open_to_public yes) and courts with no restriction mapped (open_to_public probably, with a note). Clubs, private courts and school grounds are excluded.

sport.description: Sport: tennis, padel or pickleball. Omit for any.
